scripts.test: npm run build && npm run build:test && node scripts/run-tests.mjs
scripts.test:contract: npm run build && npm run build:test && node scripts/run-tests.mjs contract
scripts.test:integration: npm run build && npm run build:test && node scripts/run-tests.mjs integration
scripts.test:discovery:boundary: npm run build && npm run build:test && MAESTRO_DISCOVERY_G0=1 node --test dist-tests/tests/integration/discovery-provider-boundary.test.js
scripts.test:acceptance: npm run build && npm run build:test && node scripts/run-tests.mjs acceptance
scripts.bench:foundation: npm run build && npm run build:test && node dist-tests/tests/acceptance/benchmark-foundation.js
scripts.typecheck:desktop: tsc -p apps/desktop/tsconfig.main.json --noEmit && tsc -p apps/desktop/tsconfig.renderer.json --noEmit && tsc -p apps/desktop/tsconfig.test.json --noEmit
scripts.test:desktop:e2e: npm run build && npm run build:desktop && playwright test -c apps/desktop/playwright.config.ts
scripts.desktop: npm run build && npm run build:desktop && node scripts/run-desktop.mjs
